OmniLoRADatasetLoader: OmniLoRA Dataset & Prompt Loader: Loads training images and .txt captions from disk or ComfyUI IMAGE/MASK inputs with aspect-ratio bucketing and alpha mask weighting.
OmniLoRAPrecomputeConditioning: OmniLoRA VAE & CLIP Pre-Cache: Pre-encodes dataset latents and text embeddings and unloads VAE/CLIP from VRAM before training.
OmniLoRALoader: OmniLoRA Load LoRA Network: Loads an existing .safetensors or .pt LoRA checkpoint into an OMNILORA_NETWORK bundle to resume training.
OmniLoRATrainer: OmniLoRA Universal Trainer (All GPUs / XPU / CUDA / ROCm): Universal FP64-free LoRA/DoRA/LoHa/LoKr trainer supporting all ComfyUI diffusion and Rectified Flow models.
OmniLoRASave: OmniLoRA Save LoRA: Exports a trained OMNILORA_NETWORK bundle to ComfyUI/models/loras/ as .safetensors with training metadata.
OmniLoRALossTracker: OmniLoRA Loss Tracker: Real-time interactive HTML5 canvas loss, EMA, noise-bin, and telemetry dashboard node.
